title: Finite discrete condensed rings are constant
statement: For every finite discrete commutative topological ring B, the sheafification of the constant presheaf with value ULift B on profinite sets with the coherent topology is isomorphic as a ring object of abelian sheaves to the condensed continuous-function ring of B. Coefficient ring objects are as in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. This includes the zero ring and empty profinite sets.

source.place: Proposition 5.3.2 (discrete coefficients); locally constant functions and coherent sheafification

proof.text: Send a constant b to the constant continuous function b. This is a natural ring homomorphism.

For a continuous section on a profinite S use the finite covering family of its clopen fibres indexed by B. Each restriction is constant, proving local surjectivity. Equal constant functions have equal values unless S is empty; on the empty S the empty family covers, proving local injectivity.
Apply GrothendieckTopology.W_of_isLocallyBijective and W_iff, then the counit isomorphism from sheafification of the continuous-function ring sheaf. Each map is a ring-object morphism.
